# zs-region-select code echo from non-left-tree options
In 苏住房G, zs-region-select's regionOptions come from the platform config areas tree, not the left-tree selected area (e.g. 320505); read-only echo shows the raw code when el-select finds no matching label.

## Problem Background
- regionOptions are sourced from the platform config areas tree and do not include the left-tree selected area code.
- In read-only echo (disabled el-select) with no matching label, the raw area code is shown instead of the name.

## Solution
- Switch to zs-select bound to regionDisplayOptions (built from regionName or allAreas as {dictValue, dictLabel}).
- Render the area name via zs-select in disabled state.

# Complex list wrong pageNew causes one row per page
In 苏住房G, multiple list requests mistakenly used POST /property/complex/pageNew, causing pagination anomalies with only 1 item returned per page.

## Problem Background
- Normal list queries wrongly called POST /property/complex/pageNew, which returned a list of only 1 item.
- Pagination parameter handling differed from the page interface, showing a single record per page.

## Solution
- Normal queries reverted to GET /property/complex/page.
- Only the advanced-filter scenario uses pageNew.

- Project: 苏住房G; Source session: 8bdf9717-be50-4471-8d56-923d2b2d1c5a; Code baseline: none

# Filed warning contract selectable and ignore uses latest row
In 苏住房G benefit contract filing lists, reserve-selection desynced selected-row fields from tableData, and filed-warning contract selection/style checks were inconsistent.

## Problem Background
- reserve-selection caused selected-row fields to fall out of sync with the current tableData.
- Filed-warning contracts had inconsistent selection state versus style judgment logic.

## Solution
- assetsLeaseContractFiling/index.vue added isWarningContract(row) unifying whetherWarning checks for 1/'1'/true.
- Both isSelectable and setRowStyle call isWarningContract(row).
- getIgnore filters by revenueContractId from the latest tableData row; ignore button disables when no warning row is selected.

## Verification and Attribution

- Project: 苏住房G; Source session: 7960611d-0d3b-4ae8-a217-98664ba2c7a2; Code baseline: none

# 列表备案字段前端追加 none 伪值
苏住房G 物业管理区域列表新增「管理主体」「收费方式」列与筛选时，后端字典缺「未备案」项，需前端追加 none 伪值并兜底缺项。

## 问题背景
- 管理主体取共有资金-管理主体，展示最新完成备案类型，未备案为空
- 后端字典 benefit_management_subject 仅 0/1/2（业委会/物业服务企业/物管会），无「未备案」
- 「未备案」非备案状态而是无记录，字典天然缺项，等补会造成「字典值+空值」两套语义

## 解决方案
- 页面加载 benefit_management_subject 后判断无 none 则追加 { dictValue:'none', dictLabel:'未备案' }
- 筛选参数 name=managementSubject，value 取 0|1|2|none
- complexFieldConfig.js 新增 managementSubject 单选 + EQ 运算符，DEFAULT_COMPLEX_FIELDS 加同名兜底项防字典加载失败缺项
- 列表列直接渲染 managementSubjectName（未备案为空、不显示占位符），收费方式走全局 dictFormatter + property_charging_method

## 验证与归属
- 涉及文件：publicQuery/complex/index.vue、zs-advanced-query/complexFieldConfig.js、docs/complex-pageNew-backend-handoff.md
- 所属项目：苏住房G；来源会话：579a0b70-5ca8-42fa-86cb-0af96a7205d9；代码基线：ad5bbd9
